citations.quote: Once an option position has been made delta neutral, the next stage is often to look at its gamma

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The Greeks are the option price's partial derivatives with respect to its inputs: delta = ∂V/∂S, gamma = ∂²V/∂S², vega = ∂V/∂σ, theta = ∂V/∂t, rho = ∂V/∂r. Under BSM, a European call has Δ = N(d₁), Γ = N'(d₁)/(S·σ·√T), and vega = S·√T·N'(d₁); signs flip for puts on delta/rho. Greeks aggregate linearly across positions.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Greeks Overview
